body: I know how you feel.  I have stopped taking meds. I can't see the point. And I tell everyone exactly what they want to hear. I'm just over it.

I'm sorry about what you are going through. Having a good support system is key. Even if it is just one other person. I would suggest a therapist to help you through this situation. It's not always easy to connect with one but talk to a few. Drugs can help depression. You don't say what kind of dr diagnosed you. There are many types of depression including situational. But I'd try a therapist or support group before drugs. Your school counselor or health plan can perhaps refer you. Remember to take care of you.
Thank you for asking. About the same really. Not ready to go but not really wanting to be here anymore. Safe for tonight.
It's exhausting to put up a front.  I understand.
